finding_reviews.rationale: X05 2024-09-30 IVX Health unsecured note (ROW-12cd5260f8c2a396). The investigation accepts spread 0 "as printed" without testing it against the printed all-in rate. The line prints "S + 0 (including 1400 PIK) 14.00 %": if this were SOFR + 0 plus 14.00 PIK the all-in would be about 18.8 pct (SOFR about 4.8 at 2024-09-30), but the page prints 14.00. The same note prints "1400 PIK 14.00 %" at 2024-06-30 and "1350 PIK 13.50 %" from 2024-12-31, and cpif publishes those quarters as Fixed with no reference rate and no spread. At 2024-09-30 alone cpif publishes coupon_type Floating, reference SOFR, spread 0. So the "S + 0" is a template artifact and the row should be published as fixed 14.00 PIK with no floating spread, like its neighbouring quarters. Under the owner convention D-031 (spread = cash + PIK margin) a 0 spread is wrong in any case. x05-zero-spread-printed-on-the-row does not fit; a row correction (coupon fixed, no spread or reference rate) is the repair.
